thread:
anne-marketing: Heads up — we need to reroute the onboarding digest for the next 4k new signees. A/B groups changed and our old welcome path is flooding the nurture stream.

sam-growth: On it. Which cohorts are affected?

anne-marketing: All users created between Feb 1–14 who came from the checklist flow (utm=check-v2). Segmentation: product_starter = true, engaged_24h = false.

leo-ops: Is this the same suppression list issue we saw last month?

anne-marketing: Related. The problem: current rule sends anyone with product_starter into the 3-email starter spiral AND the main weekly digest. We want them only in the starter spiral for 21 days.

maya-cs: Impacts support volume — if we keep sending digest, feature questions spike. Happy to take a FAQ card in the starter email to reduce tickets.

sam-growth: Proposed fix: update routing in SendGrid to check tag:starter_active_days < 21 before enqueueing weekly digest. If true, skip digest. Also add a one-off backend job to backfill tags for Feb cohort.

leo-ops: I can push a change to the routing rule. Quick pseudo:
```
if user.tags contains "product_starter" and days_since_signup <= 21:
  skip(queue="weekly_digest")
else:
  enqueue(queue="weekly_digest")
```
I'll add a safety toggle.

anne-marketing: Perfect. Sam — can you add the FAQ card + tweak subject for starter spiral 1: "Quick wins in your first 3 days"? We should test subject line variation with 20% traffic.

sam-growth: Done. Test groups: S1A (20%) subject "Quick wins in your first 3 days"; S1B (20%) subject "Start fast: 3 tips to get value"; holdout 60%.

maya-cs: I'll prepare the FAQ copy and a short snippet for the email footer with links to docs and chat.

sendgrid-bot: Scheduled update: routing rule draft created by leo-ops at 1730000100. Requires approval and feature-flag enable.

leo-ops: Pushed the rule to staging and added feature flag: feature.start_onboard_reroute. Tag backfill job queued — ETA 30m.

anne-marketing: Great. Timeline: enable feature-flag after backfill completes and QA gives thumbs. Sam, please monitor open rates and help conversion by 48h.

sam-growth: Will monitor. Adding a quick dashboard: starter_cohort_open_rate, support_ticket_rate for cohort. Ping if anything > 15% deviation. :eyes: 

maya-cs: I'll watch support volume and make routing notes in the playbook.

anne-marketing: Thanks team — will update the launch doc: https://docs.google.com/xyz (starter-digest-reroute). :party-parrot:

sendgrid-bot: Backfill job completed at 1730000420 — 4,012 users updated.

leo-ops: Enabled feature.start_onboard_reroute at 1730000450.

anne-marketing: Live. Sam — over to you for monitoring and subject-line early winners.

sam-growth: Noted — starting dashboard watch now. Will post a quick summary in #marketing in 24h.

maya-cs: Thanks all.
